programs.title: Bang Bang You're Dead
programs.desc: A group of six travelers hop on the bus from Casablanca airport headed to Marrakesh. Among them, someone has $2 million intended for a local operator to influence United Nations votes. But who's the person? AKA Our Man in Marrakesh

programs.title: The Cat and the Canary
programs.desc: A group of potential heirs gather in a forbidding old house to learn which of them will inherit a fortune. Later, they learn that a flesh-rending maniac is loose.

programs.title: The Hit
programs.desc: Ten years after Willie Parker snitched on his mob buddies for his own protection, a couple of hitmen kidnap him and take him to Paris where they plan to execute him. But along the journey, they run into all sorts of problems.

programs.title: No Man of God
programs.desc: The complex relationship that developed between FBI analyst Bill Hagmaier and serial killer Ted Bundy during Bundy's last years on death row.

programs.title: Hooligan Legacy
programs.desc: Relentless. Gritty. Brutal. A visceral story of football, betrayal and revenge. Four men execute a daring football stadium robbery, but the volatile dynamic soon turns sour, landing the villainous leader of the pack in jail. Now he is back on the streets and will stop at nothing to take his revenge.
